en.headline: Heritage Fiesta 2026 guided tours of Northern Metropolis buildings begin today
en.dek: Free guided tours and open visits to 12 historic sites in the Northern Metropolis run until 31 December, organised by the Commissioner for Heritage's Office.
body: The Heritage Fiesta 2026, themed Traversing Northern Metropolis, began its guided-tour phase on Sunday and continues until 31 December, according to the Commissioner for Heritage's Office.

The event focuses on 12 declared monuments and graded historic buildings in the Northern Metropolis, showcasing clan culture and the traditional character of the New Territories. Free guided tours are available at the participating sites, and the public may also visit during designated opening hours. A roving exhibition has been running at libraries, government venues and shopping malls since early October.

Enrolment for the first phase of guided tours, covering 1 to 15 November, closed on 14 October, with results announced on 26 October. Later phases remain open for enrolment. All activities are free of charge.

Organisers said the programme coincides with the 50th anniversary of the Antiquities Advisory Board and aims to let residents appreciate the area's blend of urban development and conservation close to their communities.

zh.headline: 2026古蹟周遊樂今日起辦北都歷史建築導賞
zh.dek: 文物保育專員辦事處主辦的免費導賞團及參觀活動，涵蓋北部都會區12處歷史建築，持續至12月31日。
body: 以穿越北部都會區為主題的2026古蹟周遊樂，由周日開始導賞團階段，直至12月31日，文物保育專員辦事處表示。
活動以北部都會區內12處法定古蹟及已評級歷史建築為焦點，展現宗族文化與新界傳統風貌。參與建築提供免費導賞團，公眾亦可於指定開放時間自行參觀。巡迴展覽自10月初起已在圖書館、政府場地及商場舉行。
第一階段導賞（11月1日至15日）報名已於10月14日截止，結果於10月26日公布。其後階段仍接受報名。所有活動免費。
主辦方指活動適逢古物諮詢委員會成立50周年，讓市民在社區附近認識北都城市與鄉郊結合、發展與保育並存的景觀。
